nodes.label: How Λ Enters a Larger Index
nodes.rationale: A coordinate must be totally ordered and Λ₁₃ is a lattice, so the only chain-valued function ℛ accepts on it is its rank: 199,130 cells become 44 values, 17.60 bits collapsing to 5.46, 4,526 to 1, thirty-one per cent surviving. An index can be an axis of another at that price.

nodes.label: Rank as Λ's Only Admissible Chain-Valued Coordinate
Coarsening Costs Resolution, Not Validity
nodes.rationale: Reduced to rank, composition stops being a map and becomes a bracket — 264 input-rank pairs, only 17 % fixing a single output, the worst spread twelve. The deduction stays valid and stops being sharp; and the branching is inside the index, so ignorance about it is not evidence of another object.
